metadata.description: Tiny batch to cross the 3,000 entity threshold.

works.title: The Handmaid's Tale (TV)
works.creator: Bruce Miller
works.description: Dystopian drama based on Margaret Atwood's novel about women subjugated in a totalitarian theocracy

works.title: Narcos
works.creator: Chris Brancato
works.description: Crime drama chronicling the rise and fall of Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar and the DEA agents pursuing him

works.title: The Wire
works.creator: David Simon
works.description: Landmark television series examining the institutions of the American city — drugs, politics, schools, media — through Baltimore's drug trade

works.title: Boardwalk Empire
works.creator: Terence Winter
works.description: Period drama set in Prohibition-era Atlantic City, following political boss Nucky Thompson through the rise of organized crime

works.title: Deadwood
works.creator: David Milch
works.description: Revisionist Western series set in the lawless gold rush town of Deadwood, South Dakota, featuring Wild Bill Hickok and Calamity Jane

works.title: Taboo
works.creator: Steven Knight
works.description: Gothic period drama starring Tom Hardy as a man who returns from Africa to claim his inheritance in Regency-era London, battling the East India Company

works.title: Gentleman Jack
works.creator: Sally Wainwright
works.description: Period drama based on the diaries of Anne Lister, a landowner in 1830s Yorkshire who is widely considered the first modern lesbian

works.title: The Underground Railroad (TV)
works.creator: Barry Jenkins
works.description: Visionary adaptation of Colson Whitehead's novel, an enslaved woman escapes via a literal underground railroad beneath the antebellum South

works.title: Alias Grace
works.creator: Sarah Polley
works.description: Miniseries based on Atwood's novel about a real Irish-Canadian servant convicted of double murder in 1843, exploring memory, truth, and female agency

works.title: John Adams (miniseries)
works.creator: Tom Hooper
works.description: HBO miniseries following America's second president from the Boston Massacre through his presidency, starring Paul Giamatti
